europe_now.title: US and Denmark Sign Greenland Security Agreement
europe_now.summary: Denmark and the United States have reached a new security arrangement that includes plans for two military bases in Greenland. The agreement was finalized following high-level diplomatic discussions concerning Arctic defense infrastructure.

sources.headline: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
Trump signs ‘fantastic’ Greenland security deal with Denmark

europe_now.title: Ukraine Expresses Outrage Over EU Sanctions Decision
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian officials have voiced strong anger after the European Union removed several Russian oligarchs from its sanctions list. The move has drawn criticism from regional observers amid ongoing diplomatic tensions surrounding the conflict.

sources.headline: Ukraine anger as EU removes Russian oligarchs from sanctions list

top_stories.title: French Energy Subsidies and Price Relief
top_stories.summary: The French government has scaled up targeted fuel price relief to help shield consumers from soaring energy costs. Officials are working to manage mounting financial pressures as broader economic challenges impact households across the region.

sources.headline: French government scales up targeted fuel price relief

top_stories.title: US Fighter Jet Incident in Germany
top_stories.summary: A United States military fighter jet recently crashed at an air base located in western Germany. Emergency responders and military personnel secured the site following the aviation incident.

sources.headline: US fighter jet crashes at air base in western Germany
